hyperedges.label: Orchestrated payment/shipping saga flow over SQS

nodes.label: API (Fastify, stateless)
nodes.rationale: Stateless so it scales horizontally and replica crashes lose nothing.

nodes.label: k6 stress scenarios (Spike, Same-user abuse, Soak, Chaos)
nodes.norm_label: k6 stress scenarios (spike, same-user abuse, soak, chaos)

nodes.label: Fail closed on Redis outage (503)
nodes.rationale: Never fall back to an unsafe path that could oversell.

nodes.label: Invariants (never break these)
nodes.rationale: Correctness guarantees all code must preserve.

nodes.label: Stock invariant (redis stock + live orders + unpersisted stream = total_stock)
nodes.norm_label: stock invariant (redis stock + live orders + unpersisted stream = total_stock)

nodes.label: Payment timeout sweeper
nodes.rationale: Cancels orders stuck in PAYMENT_PENDING beyond PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS; late success triggers refund.

nodes.label: Conditional UPDATE transitions (WHERE status=expected)
nodes.rationale: Zero rows updated means duplicate/out-of-order message: ack and ignore.

nodes.label: Postgres persists asynchronously off hot path
nodes.norm_label: postgres persists asynchronously off hot path

nodes.label: Hello flow (hello:stream through every hop)
nodes.rationale: Proves all wiring, networking, config, tests and stress tooling before business logic exists.

nodes.label: Sale state (derived: UPCOMING/ACTIVE/SOLD_OUT/ENDED)
nodes.rationale: Derived never stored; Redis TIME is authoritative so replicas agree despite clock drift.

nodes.label: Avoid naming scripts up/down (pnpm aliases)
nodes.rationale: pnpm already aliases up/down to update/downgrade so scripts would never run.

nodes.label: Cut scope from end of PLAN; never cut Phase 2 concurrency tests or verify.ts
nodes.norm_label: cut scope from end of plan; never cut phase 2 concurrency tests or verify.ts

nodes.label: Floci SQS emulator
nodes.rationale: MIT, no account/token needed, unlike LocalStack after March 2026; pinned tag 2.4.0.

nodes.label: LocalStack
nodes.rationale: Rejected: requires account/LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN; Hobby tier non-commercial.

nodes.label: Plan risks and mitigations
nodes.rationale: Floci divergence mitigated by pinned tag + contract test + ElasticMQ swap; clock drift by Redis TIME in Lua.

nodes.label: Flash Sale System Technical Specification
nodes.rationale: Accepted v0.1 spec; source of truth for behaviour.

nodes.label: API returns 202 Accepted with reservation
nodes.rationale: User learns immediately they secured a unit; payment/shipping are async.

nodes.label: Decision: Floci over LocalStack for SQS
nodes.norm_label: decision: floci over localstack for sqs
nodes.rationale: LocalStack merged images March 2026 and needs auth token; Floci needs none. Risk mitigated by pinning, plain SQS API, and contract tests; ElasticMQ swap via SQS_ENDPOINT.

nodes.label: Orchestrated (not choreographed) saga
nodes.rationale: Single state machine is easier to read, test and explain than events bouncing between services.

nodes.label: Per-replica soldOut short-circuit flag
nodes.rationale: Avoids thundering herd on Redis after sell-out.

nodes.label: Redis 7 (AOF everysec)
nodes.rationale: Hot-path source of truth; AOF everysec trades up to ~1s of reservation loss for speed.

nodes.label: Redis sale keys (meta, stock, buyers, reservations)
nodes.norm_label: redis sale keys (meta, stock, buyers, reservations)
nodes.rationale: Shared {id} hash tag keeps keys in one slot for future Redis Cluster.

nodes.label: Purchase decision made in Redis, not DB
nodes.norm_label: purchase decision made in redis, not db
nodes.rationale: Redis runs scripts serially: linearizable with no locks or DB row contention; O(1).

nodes.label: Redis stream as outbox
nodes.rationale: Reservation and event written in same script, so no 2PC between Redis and queue.

nodes.label: One active order per user per sale
nodes.norm_label: one active order per user per sale
nodes.rationale: Enforced in two layers: Redis SISMEMBER and partial unique index in Postgres.

nodes.label: Retry allowed after failed payment
nodes.rationale: Product decision: a failed payment should not lock someone out.

nodes.label: Depend on MessageBus interface, not SQS SDK
nodes.norm_label: depend on messagebus interface, not sqs sdk
